Name: Jeremoth, Son of Mushi
Summary: Son of Mushi, named among the sons of Mushi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:23: Son of Mushi, named among the sons of Mushi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeremoth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
